violations.description: COOKING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (5 pts): Potentially hazardous food noted not being adequately reheated. Observed beans rice meats and other ingredients being reheated in food warming devices not designed to rapidly reheat potentially hazardous food items.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Hand washing lavatory in ware-washing area noted blocked with stuff. A waste receptacle was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the kitchen closest to the chip dispensing cabinet.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of house made quacomole rice and house made sauces was noted not being properly dated for disposition.
DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): Sanitizer test kit noted not provided.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not properly working at the hand washing lavatory in the kitchen and food prep area.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Observed personal phones and bluetooth speakers being used on the prep top cooler cutting boards.

EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Observed empolyee in dish room loading soiled dishes and equipment into dish machine and then proceeded to unload clean sanitized utensils without proper handwashing and glove changing.
